partnershipPlan: Two patient partners, one who completed the remote programme and one who stopped the centre programme, review the completion rule and the plain-language summary for the board.
socialListening: No social media listening; the programme's exit feedback cards from 2025 are summarised.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Forty minutes each way twice a week was more than my heart could take, never mind the exercise.
Composite paraphrase: After I missed two calls I felt I had failed, so I stopped answering.
items.implication: Report weeks engaged before stopping for remote patients.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: She could not leave her mother, so the home programme was the only one she could start.
Composite paraphrase: We never counted the remote people who never logged in, so of course their numbers looked good.

summary: Four composite voices on distance, quiet dropout, caring and fair counting.
